Never introduce a third source without evidence: three traced sources alone cause capture. Baseline true pools: 10000000 (nothing traced), 3500000 (timing only), 2500000 (one source only), 875000 (timing+one source), 625000 (both sources), 218750 (timing+both). Announcements round to 1 significant figure and may be distorted by factor 3; do not trust a single announcement. Region and source-following are independent. Quick entries allowed morning/afternoon only; max 10 quick and 2 timed daily.
